artifact.note: Caps are ceilings, not targets. Reaching a cap is a normal terminating condition reported in the run summary - never an error, and never a reason to raise the cap.

cli.invocation_note: Subprocess with a stdout-JSON contract. No module of ai-job-search is imported (JS-R3).
cli.results_per_page_note: Fixed by the CLI. Not configurable here; recorded so a run summary can state the page arithmetic.

volume_caps.concurrency_note: Serial by construction. The adapter has no parallel code path against this source (P0_SPEC 7.3).

detail_fetch_policy.rule: detail is fetched only for search hits that are not already known under the L1 identity (source_portal, external_id).
detail_fetch_policy.basis: P0_SPEC 7.3 - 'detail fetched only for pre-filtered candidates, never for every search hit'.
detail_fetch_policy.not_a_policy_filter: The pre-filter is an identity/efficiency filter. No posting is ever skipped for a policy reason - the adapter performs no policy evaluation (P0_SPEC 7.2).

query_seeds.basis: P0_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md 7.6 - career doc 4's four target buckets. Seeds queries only; NOT an eligibility filter (OR-02 residual open).
query_seeds.remote_filter_note: Server-side volume reducer only. Never evidence. The JD text decides work mode; a portal filter that conflicts with it yields AMBIGUOUS under WM-N1 (P0_SPEC 4.3, 7.6).

persistence.identity_contract: scraped_jobs.external_id is UNIQUE. Insertion uses INSERT OR IGNORE, so a re-run of the same bounded query inserts zero duplicate rows.
persistence.dedup_boundary: This is the existing repository identity contract only (L1, namespaced source-native id). L2 URL canonicalization, L3 company+title+location, L4 ATS requisition id, cross-source matching against opportunities, and identity_uncertain handling are P0-07 and are NOT implemented here (P0_SPEC 8).

provenance_store.rationale: P0_SPEC 7.5 defines raw_payload_ref as a 'pointer to the retained raw record'. The pointer is a run-scoped file path, so no schema column and no migration is required. Run-scoped paths mean nothing is ever overwritten.

scoring.note: P0-06 does not score. match_score, classification, matched_skills, matched_domains, red_flags and recommendation are left NULL on rows this pipeline writes - they belong to the scorer, which is downstream of the gate and out of scope here.
